output.answer: As of the most recent FINRA settlement date (October 30, 2026), Hims & Hers Health (NYSE: HIMS) had short interest of 51,657,110 shares (~51.66 million), about 25.09% of the public float, with a short interest ratio (days to cover) of 5.8 based on average daily volume of ~22.37 million shares — roughly $1.43 billion sold short. That was a 3.40% decline from the prior report (53.47 million shares as of October 15, 2026). Short interest remains elevated at ~23–25% of float, making HIMS one of the most shorted mid-cap stocks ahead of its Q3 2026 earnings, which missed estimates (net loss of $33 million, EPS -$0.14).
caveats: Short interest is reported on a lag (FINRA settlement dates twice monthly); the 51.66M-share figure is as of the October 30, 2026 settlement — actual current short positions may differ, and the mid-November report (settled ~Nov 14) is not yet published as of Nov 11, 2026.

Aggregators differ slightly in methodology: MarketBeat shows 25.09% of float / 5.84 days to cover, while StockAnalysis shows 24.89% of float / 5.12 days to cover for the same underlying report; Benzinga cites ~23%. The variance reflects differing float/volume baselines, not different positions.
Q3 2026 earnings (Nov 10, 2026) showed a net loss and revenue miss; the resulting trading may have already changed short positioning after the Oct 30 settlement date.
